name: Thaumaturgy: Path of Conjuring — 3 Advanced — Power Over Life

system.description: You may create simple simulacra of living beings. These creations lack free will, emotions, and creativity, but will follow your orders. To conjure the simulacra requires the expenditure of five Blood Traits. The beings last for one evening and may not be made permanent. Simulacra (or golems) created in this way have seven Physical Traits, no Mental or Social Traits, no Abilities, and are immune to all Mental and Social Challenges.
